subtitle: [{area} · ]{basis} · {window} · {count}
take_two_seasons_contract: {n} of {total} sales went under contract {span} or {span2}.
take_list_by: List by {when} to be on the market as the season opens.
take_flat: Sales spread across the year with no clear busy season.
warn_thin: Only {n} sales in the window, too few to call a season ({min} or more): the chart shows the dots with no season boxes.
warn_one_season: The sales cover {months} months, one season: a single unusual month can look like a pattern. 24 months shows whether it repeats.
warn_short_data: The export starts {start}, so the chart covers {months} months, not the {lookback} asked for. Export closed sales from the last {need} months for the full window.
warn_close_basis: The export has no contract dates, so the dots are placed by close date, about a month after buyers committed. Add the Contract Date column to read the buying pattern itself.
warn_mixed_basis: {n} of {total} sales have no contract date and are placed by close date.
warn_no_dom: The export has no days on market (CDOM), so the takeaway can't say when to list.
warn_override: The busy season is the agent's ({span}), not the one the sales show.
